lines.text: NASA has awarded a contract to Omitron Inc. to acquire orbital safety analysis services intended to protect NASA spaceflight assets and astronaut lives.
The indefinite-delivery contract carries an estimated value of approximately $23.5 million spanning a five-year period of performance.
The agreement covers conjunction assessment screening services for all uncrewed spacecraft operated by NASA.

Additionally, the arrangement includes support for human spaceflight activities alongside orbital safety analysis support directed toward the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration’s Office of Space Commerce.
